articles.title: Honey Singh skips Maharashtra Cyber questioning: What happens next for the rapper?
articles.description: Honey Singh has been summoned by Maharashtra Cyber and was asked to appear before officials in connection with a complaint filed against him over allegedly objectionable remarks made during a concert. But, the rapper failed to appear before the investigating officer on Monday.

articles.title: Honey Singh asks for more time after Maharashtra Cyber summons over alleged remarks
articles.description: Singer Honey Singh has been summoned by Maharashtra Cyber. He was asked to appear before officials regarding alleged objectionable remarks made during a concert.

articles.title: Yo Yo Honey Singh seeks additional time to appear before Maharashtra Cyber over objectionable remarks at concert
articles.description: Rapper and singer Yo Yo Honey Singh did not turn up for questioning on Monday as directed by Maharashtra Cyber Cell. Known all about it.

articles.title: Entertainment News | Singer Honey Singh Summoned by Maharashtra Cyber over Alleged Objectionable Remarks During Concert
articles.description: Get latest articles and stories on Entertainment at LatestLY. Rapper and singer Hirdesh Singh, popularly known as Yo Yo Honey Singh, has sought additional time from Maharashtra Cyber to appear before the investigating officer after he did not turn up for questioning on Monday.

articles.title: Yo Yo Honey Singh requests more time from Maharashtra Cyber after missing questioning
articles.description: Rapper Yo Yo Honey Singh skipped his scheduled questioning before Maharashtra Cyber over alleged objectionable remarks made at a concert and requested additional time to appear.
